bio: Jenna is a London/Essex-based graphic designer with a focus on branding, marketing, and immersive visual experiences. Her work explores how design can move beyond static outcomes to create engaging, sensory-driven interactions that connect with audiences on a deeper level. She has worked with local and independent clients, developing her ability to translate ideas into considered visual identities across both print and digital formats. Her approach is shaped by a strong interest in how design operates within real-world contexts, balancing creativity with clear communication. Jenna is particularly interested in the intersection of design and experience, often drawing inspiration from automotive and motorsport culture. She approaches briefs with energy and curiosity, aiming to create work that is both visually striking and memorable.

projects.title: Aer
projects.description:
AER – AER is a speculative brand concept for a high-performance racing team, centred around an AI-driven system that supports drivers both on and off the track. The project explores how data, technology, and design can work together to enhance performance while creating a strong and immersive brand identity.
 
 The visual language reflects precision, speed, and control, combining clean design with dynamic elements to communicate a forward-thinking approach to motorsport. AER positions itself as more than a team, but as a system built to optimise performance and redefine the relationship between driver and machine.

projects.title: Veil
projects.description: VEIL – Veil is an brand designed for immersive spaces, where visuals are activated through the presence of the viewer. Combining static posters with projection and real-time interaction.
